method: Playwright-driven recon of the live site plus reverse-engineered Next.js App Router flight payloads and urql/GraphQL persisted queries; every measure, state, report, article and FAQ value was harvested from the upstream API responses, and every media file was downloaded from its resolved assets.americashealthrankings.org URL. Report bodies were converted from upstream Lexical ASTs to HTML; report PDFs/CSVs/pptx/zip/xlsx/mp4 attachments, per-state summary PDFs, article author headshots, US map SVG geometry, UI icon SVGs and the four OptumSans woff2 fonts are byte-identical upstream files inventoried in asset_inventory.json.
notes: All 2295 media files (765.1 MB) carry per-file source_url + bytes + sha256 in asset_inventory.json and validate with scripts/check_asset_inventory.py. No placeholder or generated images are used: every visual asset resolves to an upstream URL (assets.americashealthrankings.org), including 1577 png, 147 jpg, 402 pdf, 10 csv, 6 ppt, 17 zip, 1 mp4, avif/svg/ico and 4 woff2 fonts. Measure covid_deaths_provisional_annual mirrors the live site's HTTP 500 with an error page instead of harvested data (upstream fails on this measure). static/css/ahr.css and all templates are original mirror implementations matching upstream design tokens (navy #003c71, blue #0066f5, quintile ramp #a4d7fc/#50adf0/#2294e0/#0d6cb5/#174b7b, nodata #d1d1d1, Optum Sans type). Benchmark users (password TestPass123!) and their saved items are original fixtures; all data values are harvested.
